ayahs.arabicText: قَدْ اَفْلَحَ الْمُؤْمِنُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: Certainly will the believers have succeeded:

ayahs.arabicText: الَّذِیْنَ هُمْ فِیْ صَلَاتِهِمْ خٰشِعُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: They who are during their prayer humbly submissive

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ هُمْ عَنِ اللَّغْوِ مُعْرِضُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: And they who turn away from ill speech

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ هُمْ لِلزَّكٰوةِ فٰعِلُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: And they who are observant of zakah

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ هُمْ لِفُرُوْجِهِمْ حٰفِظُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: And they who guard their private parts

ayahs.arabicText: اِلَّا عَلٰۤى اَزْوَاجِهِمْ اَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ اَیْمَانُهُمْ فَاِنَّهُمْ غَیْرُ مَلُوْمِیْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they will not be blamed -

ayahs.arabicText: فَمَنِ ابْتَغٰى وَرَآءَ ذٰلِكَ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْعٰدُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: But whoever seeks beyond that, then those are the transgressors -

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ هُمْ لِاَمٰنٰتِهِمْ وَ عَهْدِهِمْ رٰعُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: And they who are to their trusts and their promises attentive

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ هُمْ عَلٰى صَلَوٰتِهِمْ یُحَافِظُوْنَۘ
ayahs.translation: And they who carefully maintain their prayers -

ayahs.arabicText: اُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْوٰرِثُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: Those are the inheritors

ayahs.arabicText: الَّذِیْنَ یَرِثُوْنَ الْفِرْدَوْسَ١ؕ هُمْ فِیْهَا خٰلِدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Who will inherit al-Firdaus. They will abide therein eternally.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ مِنْ سُلٰلَةٍ مِّنْ طِیْنٍۚ
ayahs.translation: And certainly did We create man from an extract of clay.

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنٰهُ نُطْفَةً فِیْ قَرَارٍ مَّكِیْنٍ۪
ayahs.translation: Then We placed him as a sperm-drop in a firm lodging.

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ خَلَقْنَا النُّطْفَةَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقْنَا الْعَلَقَةَ مُضْغَةً فَخَلَقْنَا الْمُضْغَةَ عِظٰمًا فَكَسَوْنَا الْعِظٰمَ لَحْمًا١ۗ ثُمَّ اَنْشَاْنٰهُ خَلْقًا اٰخَرَ١ؕ فَتَبٰرَكَ اللّٰهُ اَحْسَنُ الْخٰلِقِیْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: Then We made the sperm-drop into a clinging clot, and We made the clot into a lump [of flesh], and We made [from] the lump, bones, and We covered the bones with flesh; then We developed him into another creation. So blessed is Allah, the best of creators.

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ اِنَّكُمْ بَعْدَ ذٰلِكَ لَمَیِّتُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: Then indeed, after that you are to die.

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ اِنَّكُمْ یَوْمَ الْقِیٰمَةِ تُبْعَثُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, will be resurrected.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعَ طَرَآئِقَ١ۖۗ وَ مَا كُنَّا عَنِ الْخَلْقِ غٰفِلِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We have created above you seven layered heavens, and never have We been of [Our] creation unaware.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَنْزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءًۢ بِقَدَرٍ فَاَسْكَنّٰهُ فِی الْاَرْضِ١ۖۗ وَ اِنَّا عَلٰى ذَهَابٍۭ بِهٖ لَقٰدِرُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: And We have sent down rain from the sky in a measured amount and settled it in the earth. And indeed, We are Able to take it away.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَنْشَاْنَا لَكُمْ بِهٖ جَنّٰتٍ مِّنْ نَّخِیْلٍ وَّ اَعْنَابٍ١ۘ لَكُمْ فِیْهَا فَوَاكِهُ كَثِیْرَةٌ وَّ مِنْهَا تَاْكُلُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: And We brought forth for you thereby gardens of palm trees and grapevines in which for you are abundant fruits and from which you eat.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ شَجَرَةً تَخْرُجُ مِنْ طُوْرِ سَیْنَآءَ تَنْۢبُتُ بِالدُّهْنِ وَ صِبْغٍ لِّلْاٰكِلِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: And [We brought forth] a tree issuing from Mount Sinai which produces oil and food for those who eat.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنَّ لَكُمْ فِی الْاَنْعَامِ لَعِبْرَةً١ؕ نُسْقِیْكُمْ مِّمَّا فِیْ بُطُوْنِهَا وَ لَكُمْ فِیْهَا مَنَافِعُ كَثِیْرَةٌ وَّ مِنْهَا تَاْكُلُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: And indeed, for you in livestock is a lesson. We give you drink from that which is in their bellies, and for you in them are numerous benefits, and from them you eat.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ عَلَیْهَا وَ عَلَى الْفُلْكِ تُحْمَلُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: And upon them and on ships you are carried.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ اَرْسَلْنَا نُوْحًا اِلٰى قَوْمِهٖ فَقَالَ یٰقَوْمِ اعْبُدُوا اللّٰهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِّنْ اِلٰهٍ غَیْرُهٗ١ؕ اَفَلَا تَتَّقُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We had certainly sent Noah to his people, and he said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him?"

ayahs.arabicText: فَقَالَ الْمَلَؤُا الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا مِنْ قَوْمِهٖ مَا هٰذَاۤ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ١ۙ یُرِیْدُ اَنْ یَّتَفَضَّلَ عَلَیْكُمْ١ؕ وَ لَوْ شَآءَ اللّٰهُ لَاَنْزَلَ مَلٰٓئِكَةً١ۖۚ مَّا سَمِعْنَا بِهٰذَا فِیْۤ اٰبَآئِنَا الْاَوَّلِیْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: But the eminent among those who disbelieved from his people said, "This is not but a man like yourselves who wishes to take precedence over you; and if Allah had willed [to send a messenger], He would have sent down angels. We have not heard of this among our forefathers.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنْ هُوَ اِلَّا رَجُلٌۢ بِهٖ جِنَّةٌ فَتَرَبَّصُوْا بِهٖ حَتّٰى حِیْنٍ
ayahs.translation: He is not but a man possessed with madness, so wait concerning him for a time."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ رَبِّ انْصُرْنِیْ بِمَا كَذَّبُوْنِ
ayahs.translation: [Noah] said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me."

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَوْحَیْنَاۤ اِلَیْهِ اَنِ اصْنَعِ الْفُلْكَ بِاَعْیُنِنَا وَ وَحْیِنَا فَاِذَا جَآءَ اَمْرُنَا وَ فَارَ التَّنُّوْرُ١ۙ فَاسْلُكْ فِیْهَا مِنْ كُلٍّ زَوْجَیْنِ اثْنَیْنِ وَ اَهْلَكَ اِلَّا مَنْ سَبَقَ عَلَیْهِ الْقَوْلُ مِنْهُمْ١ۚ وَ لَا تُخَاطِبْنِیْ فِی الَّذِیْنَ ظَلَمُوْا١ۚ اِنَّهُمْ مُّغْرَقُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: So We inspired to him, "Construct the ship under Our observation, and Our inspiration, and when Our command comes and the oven overflows, put into the ship from each [creature] two mates and your family, except those for whom the decree [of destruction] has proceeded. And do not address Me concerning those who have wronged; indeed, they are to be drowned.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاِذَا اسْتَوَیْتَ اَنْتَ وَ مَنْ مَّعَكَ عَلَى الْفُلْكِ فَقُلِ الْحَمْدُ لِلّٰهِ الَّذِیْ نَجّٰىنَا مِنَ الْقَوْمِ الظّٰلِمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: And when you have boarded the ship, you and those with you, then say, 'Praise to Allah who has saved us from the wrongdoing people.'

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قُلْ رَّبِّ اَنْزِلْنِیْ مُنْزَلًا مُّبٰرَكًا وَّ اَنْتَ خَیْرُ الْمُنْزِلِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: And say, 'My Lord, let me land at a blessed landing place, and You are the best to accommodate [us].' "

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ فِیْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰیٰتٍ وَّ اِنْ كُنَّا لَمُبْتَلِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Indeed in that are signs, and indeed, We are ever testing [Our servants].

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ اَنْشَاْنَا مِنْۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْنًا اٰخَرِیْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: Then We produced after them a generation of others.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَرْسَلْنَا فِیْهِمْ رَسُوْلًا مِّنْهُمْ اَنِ اعْبُدُوا اللّٰهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِّنْ اِلٰهٍ غَیْرُهٗ١ؕ اَفَلَا تَتَّقُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: And We sent among them a messenger from themselves, [saying], "Worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him?"

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالَ الْمَلَاُ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا وَ كَذَّبُوْا بِلِقَآءِ الْاٰخِرَةِ وَ اَتْرَفْنٰهُمْ فِی الْحَیٰوةِ الدُّنْیَا١ۙ مَا هٰذَاۤ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ١ۙ یَاْكُلُ مِمَّا تَاْكُلُوْنَ مِنْهُ وَ یَشْرَبُ مِمَّا تَشْرَبُوْنَ۪ۙ
ayahs.translation: And the eminent among his people who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter while We had given them luxury in the worldly life said, "This is not but a man like yourselves. He eats of that from which you eat and drinks of what you drink.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَئِنْ اَطَعْتُمْ بَشَرًا مِّثْلَكُمْ اِنَّكُمْ اِذًا لَّخٰسِرُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: And if you should obey a man like yourselves, indeed, you would then be losers.

ayahs.arabicText: اَیَعِدُكُمْ اَنَّكُمْ اِذَا مِتُّمْ وَ كُنْتُمْ تُرَابًا وَّ عِظَامًا اَنَّكُمْ مُّخْرَجُوْنَ۪ۙ
ayahs.translation: Does he promise you that when you have died and become dust and bones that you will be brought forth [once more]?

ayahs.arabicText: هَیْهَاتَ هَیْهَاتَ لِمَا تُوْعَدُوْنَ۪ۙ
ayahs.translation: How far, how far, is that which you are promised.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنْ هِیَ اِلَّا حَیَاتُنَا الدُّنْیَا نَمُوْتُ وَ نَحْیَا وَ مَا نَحْنُ بِمَبْعُوْثِیْنَ۪ۙ
ayahs.translation: Life is not but our worldly life - we die and live, but we will not be resurrected.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنْ هُوَ اِلَّا رَجُلُ اِ۟فْتَرٰى عَلَى اللّٰهِ كَذِبًا وَّ مَا نَحْنُ لَهٗ بِمُؤْمِنِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: He is not but a man who has invented a lie about Allah, and we will not believe him."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ رَبِّ انْصُرْنِیْ بِمَا كَذَّبُوْنِ
ayahs.translation: He said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ عَمَّا قَلِیْلٍ لَّیُصْبِحُنَّ نٰدِمِیْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: [Allah] said, "After a little, they will surely become regretful."

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّیْحَةُ بِالْحَقِّ فَجَعَلْنٰهُمْ غُثَآءً١ۚ فَبُعْدًا لِّلْقَوْمِ الظّٰلِمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: So the shriek seized them in truth, and We made them as [plant] stubble. Then away with the wrongdoing people.

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ اَنْشَاْنَا مِنْۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قُرُوْنًا اٰخَرِیْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: Then We produced after them other generations.

ayahs.arabicText: مَا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ اُمَّةٍ اَجَلَهَا وَ مَا یَسْتَاْخِرُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: No nation will precede its time [of termination], nor will they remain [thereafter].

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ اَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا تَتْرَا١ؕ كُلَّمَا جَآءَ اُمَّةً رَّسُوْلُهَا كَذَّبُوْهُ فَاَتْبَعْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ بَعْضًا وَّ جَعَلْنٰهُمْ اَحَادِیْثَ١ۚ فَبُعْدًا لِّقَوْمٍ لَّا یُؤْمِنُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Then We sent Our messengers in succession. Every time there came to a nation its messenger, they denied him, so We made them follow one another [to destruction], and We made them narrations. So away with a people who do not believe.

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ اَرْسَلْنَا مُوْسٰى وَ اَخَاهُ هٰرُوْنَ١ۙ۬ بِاٰیٰتِنَا وَ سُلْطٰنٍ مُّبِیْنٍۙ
ayahs.translation: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs and a clear authority

ayahs.arabicText: اِلٰى فِرْعَوْنَ وَ مَلَاۡئِهٖ فَاسْتَكْبَرُوْا وَ كَانُوْا قَوْمًا عَالِیْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: To Pharaoh and his establishment, but they were arrogant and were a haughty people.

ayahs.arabicText: فَقَالُوْۤا اَنُؤْمِنُ لِبَشَرَیْنِ مِثْلِنَا وَ قَوْمُهُمَا لَنَا عٰبِدُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: They said, "Should we believe two men like ourselves while their people are for us in servitude?"

ayahs.arabicText: فَكَذَّبُوْهُمَا فَكَانُوْا مِنَ الْمُهْلَكِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: So they denied them and were of those destroyed.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا مُوْسَى الْكِتٰبَ لَعَلَّهُمْ یَهْتَدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture that perhaps they would be guided.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ جَعَلْنَا ابْنَ مَرْیَمَ وَ اُمَّهٗۤ اٰیَةً وَّ اٰوَیْنٰهُمَاۤ اِلٰى رَبْوَةٍ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍ وَّ مَعِیْنٍ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign and sheltered them within a high ground having level [areas] and flowing water.

ayahs.arabicText: یٰۤاَیُّهَا الرُّسُلُ كُلُوْا مِنَ الطَّیِّبٰتِ وَ اعْمَلُوْا صَالِحًا١ؕ اِنِّیْ بِمَا تَعْمَلُوْنَ عَلِیْمٌؕ
ayahs.translation: [Allah said], "O messengers, eat from the good foods and work righteousness. Indeed, I, of what you do, am Knowing.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنَّ هٰذِهٖۤ اُمَّتُكُمْ اُمَّةً وَّاحِدَةً وَّ اَنَا رَبُّكُمْ فَاتَّقُوْنِ
ayahs.translation: And indeed this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so fear Me."

ayahs.arabicText: فَتَقَطَّعُوْۤا اَمْرَهُمْ بَیْنَهُمْ زُبُرًا١ؕ كُلُّ حِزْبٍۭ بِمَا لَدَیْهِمْ فَرِحُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: But the people divided their religion among them into sects - each faction, in what it has, rejoicing.

ayahs.arabicText: فَذَرْهُمْ فِیْ غَمْرَتِهِمْ حَتّٰى حِیْنٍ
ayahs.translation: So leave them in their confusion for a time.

ayahs.arabicText: اَیَحْسَبُوْنَ اَنَّمَا نُمِدُّهُمْ بِهٖ مِنْ مَّالٍ وَّ بَنِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: Do they think that what We extend to them of wealth and children

ayahs.arabicText: نُسَارِعُ لَهُمْ فِی الْخَیْرٰتِ١ؕ بَلْ لَّا یَشْعُرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Is [because] We hasten for them good things? Rather, they do not perceive.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ الَّذِیْنَ هُمْ مِّنْ خَشْیَةِ رَبِّهِمْ مُّشْفِقُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, they who are apprehensive from fear of their Lord

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ هُمْ بِاٰیٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ یُؤْمِنُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: And they who believe in the signs of their Lord

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ هُمْ بِرَبِّهِمْ لَا یُشْرِكُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: And they who do not associate anything with their Lord

ayahs.arabicText: وَ الَّذِیْنَ یُؤْتُوْنَ مَاۤ اٰتَوْا وَّ قُلُوْبُهُمْ وَجِلَةٌ اَنَّهُمْ اِلٰى رَبِّهِمْ رٰجِعُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: And they who give what they give while their hearts are fearful because they will be returning to their Lord -

ayahs.arabicText: اُولٰٓئِكَ یُسٰرِعُوْنَ فِی الْخَیْرٰتِ وَ هُمْ لَهَا سٰبِقُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: It is those who hasten to good deeds, and they outstrip [others] therein.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا اِلَّا وُسْعَهَا وَ لَدَیْنَا كِتٰبٌ یَّنْطِقُ بِالْحَقِّ وَ هُمْ لَا یُظْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We charge no soul except [with that within] its capacity, and with Us is a record which speaks with truth; and they will not be wronged.

ayahs.arabicText: بَلْ قُلُوْبُهُمْ فِیْ غَمْرَةٍ مِّنْ هٰذَا وَ لَهُمْ اَعْمَالٌ مِّنْ دُوْنِ ذٰلِكَ هُمْ لَهَا عٰمِلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: But their hearts are covered with confusion over this, and they have [evil] deeds besides disbelief which they are doing,

ayahs.arabicText: حَتّٰۤى اِذَاۤ اَخَذْنَا مُتْرَفِیْهِمْ بِالْعَذَابِ اِذَا هُمْ یَجْئَرُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: Until when We seize their affluent ones with punishment, at once they are crying [to Allah] for help.

ayahs.arabicText: لَا تَجْئَرُوا الْیَوْمَ١۫ اِنَّكُمْ مِّنَّا لَا تُنْصَرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Do not cry out today. Indeed, by Us you will not be helped.

ayahs.arabicText: قَدْ كَانَتْ اٰیٰتِیْ تُتْلٰى عَلَیْكُمْ فَكُنْتُمْ عَلٰۤى اَعْقَابِكُمْ تَنْكِصُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: My verses had already been recited to you, but you were turning back on your heels

ayahs.arabicText: مُسْتَكْبِرِیْنَ١ۖۗ بِهٖ سٰمِرًا تَهْجُرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: In arrogance regarding it, conversing by night, speaking evil.

ayahs.arabicText: اَفَلَمْ یَدَّبَّرُوا الْقَوْلَ اَمْ جَآءَهُمْ مَّا لَمْ یَاْتِ اٰبَآءَهُمُ الْاَوَّلِیْنَ٘
ayahs.translation: Then have they not reflected over the Qur'an, or has there come to them that which had not come to their forefathers?

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ لَمْ یَعْرِفُوْا رَسُوْلَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَهٗ مُنْكِرُوْنَ٘
ayahs.translation: Or did they not know their Messenger, so they are toward him disacknowledging?

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ یَقُوْلُوْنَ بِهٖ جِنَّةٌ١ؕ بَلْ جَآءَهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ وَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كٰرِهُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Or do they say, "In him is madness?" Rather, he brought them the truth, but most of them, to the truth, are averse.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَوِ اتَّبَعَ الْحَقُّ اَهْوَآءَهُمْ لَفَسَدَتِ السَّمٰوٰتُ وَ الْاَرْضُ وَ مَنْ فِیْهِنَّ١ؕ بَلْ اَتَیْنٰهُمْ بِذِكْرِهِمْ فَهُمْ عَنْ ذِكْرِهِمْ مُّعْرِضُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: But if the Truth had followed their inclinations, the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them would have been ruined. Rather, We have brought them their message, but they, from their message, are turning away.

ayahs.arabicText: اَمْ تَسْئَلُهُمْ خَرْجًا فَخَرَاجُ رَبِّكَ خَیْرٌ١ۖۗ وَّ هُوَ خَیْرُ الرّٰزِقِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Or do you, [O Muhammad], ask them for payment? But the reward of your Lord is best, and He is the best of providers.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنَّكَ لَتَدْعُوْهُمْ اِلٰى صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِیْمٍ
ayahs.translation: And indeed, you invite them to a straight path.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنَّ الَّذِیْنَ لَا یُؤْمِنُوْنَ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ عَنِ الصِّرَاطِ لَنٰكِبُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: But indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter are deviating from the path.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَوْ رَحِمْنٰهُمْ وَ كَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِمْ مِّنْ ضُرٍّ لَّلَجُّوْا فِیْ طُغْیَانِهِمْ یَعْمَهُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And even if We gave them mercy and removed what was upon them of affliction, they would persist in their transgression, wandering blindly.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ اَخَذْنٰهُمْ بِالْعَذَابِ فَمَا اسْتَكَانُوْا لِرَبِّهِمْ وَ مَا یَتَضَرَّعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We had gripped them with suffering [as a warning], but they did not yield to their Lord, nor did they humbly supplicate, [and will continue thus]

ayahs.arabicText: حَتّٰۤى اِذَا فَتَحْنَا عَلَیْهِمْ بَابًا ذَا عَذَابٍ شَدِیْدٍ اِذَا هُمْ فِیْهِ مُبْلِسُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Until when We have opened before them a door of severe punishment, immediately they will be therein in despair.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ هُوَ الَّذِیْۤ اَنْشَاَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَ الْاَبْصَارَ وَ الْاَفْئِدَةَ١ؕ قَلِیْلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And it is He who produced for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ هُوَ الَّذِیْ ذَرَاَكُمْ فِی الْاَرْضِ وَ اِلَیْهِ تُحْشَرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And it is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ هُوَ الَّذِیْ یُحْیٖ وَ یُمِیْتُ وَ لَهُ اخْتِلَافُ الَّیْلِ وَ النَّهَارِ١ؕ اَفَلَا تَعْقِلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And it is He who gives life and causes death, and His is the alternation of the night and the day. Then will you not reason?

ayahs.arabicText: بَلْ قَالُوْا مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ الْاَوَّلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Rather, they say like what the former peoples said.

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْۤا ءَاِذَا مِتْنَا وَ كُنَّا تُرَابًا وَّ عِظَامًا ءَاِنَّا لَمَبْعُوْثُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: They said, "When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?

ayahs.arabicText: لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا نَحْنُ وَ اٰبَآؤُنَا هٰذَا مِنْ قَبْلُ اِنْ هٰذَاۤ اِلَّاۤ اَسَاطِیْرُ الْاَوَّلِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: We have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before; this is not but legends of the former peoples."

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ لِّمَنِ الْاَرْضُ وَ مَنْ فِیْهَاۤ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Say, [O Muhammad], "To whom belongs the earth and whoever is in it, if you should know?"

ayahs.arabicText: سَیَقُوْلُوْنَ لِلّٰهِ١ؕ قُلْ اَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: They will say, "To Allah." Say, "Then will you not remember?"

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ مَنْ رَّبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ السَّبْعِ وَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِیْمِ
ayahs.translation: Say, "Who is Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the Great Throne?"

ayahs.arabicText: سَیَقُوْلُوْنَ لِلّٰهِ١ؕ قُلْ اَفَلَا تَتَّقُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: They will say, "[They belong] to Allah." Say, "Then will you not fear Him?"

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ مَنْۢ بِیَدِهٖ مَلَكُوْتُ كُلِّ شَیْءٍ وَّ هُوَ یُجِیْرُ وَ لَا یُجَارُ عَلَیْهِ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Say, "In whose hand is the realm of all things - and He protects while none can protect against Him - if you should know?"

ayahs.arabicText: سَیَقُوْلُوْنَ لِلّٰهِ١ؕ قُلْ فَاَنّٰى تُسْحَرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: They will say, "[All belongs] to Allah." Say, "Then how are you deluded?"

ayahs.arabicText: بَلْ اَتَیْنٰهُمْ بِالْحَقِّ وَ اِنَّهُمْ لَكٰذِبُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Rather, We have brought them the truth, and indeed they are liars.

ayahs.arabicText: مَا اتَّخَذَ اللّٰهُ مِنْ وَّلَدٍ وَّ مَا كَانَ مَعَهٗ مِنْ اِلٰهٍ اِذًا لَّذَهَبَ كُلُّ اِلٰهٍۭ بِمَا خَلَقَ وَ لَعَلَا بَعْضُهُمْ عَلٰى بَعْضٍ١ؕ سُبْحٰنَ اللّٰهِ عَمَّا یَصِفُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: Allah has not taken any son, nor has there ever been with Him any deity. [If there had been], then each deity would have taken what it created, and some of them would have sought to overcome others. Exalted is Allah above what they describe [concerning Him].

ayahs.arabicText: عٰلِمِ الْغَیْبِ وَ الشَّهَادَةِ فَتَعٰلٰى عَمَّا یُشْرِكُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: [He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, so high is He above what they associate [with Him].

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ رَّبِّ اِمَّا تُرِیَنِّیْ مَا یُوْعَدُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: Say, [O Muhammad], "My Lord, if You should show me that which they are promised,

ayahs.arabicText: رَبِّ فَلَا تَجْعَلْنِیْ فِی الْقَوْمِ الظّٰلِمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: My Lord, then do not place me among the wrongdoing people."

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِنَّا عَلٰۤى اَنْ نُّرِیَكَ مَا نَعِدُهُمْ لَقٰدِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And indeed, We are able to show you what We have promised them.

ayahs.arabicText: اِدْفَعْ بِالَّتِیْ هِیَ اَحْسَنُ السَّیِّئَةَ١ؕ نَحْنُ اَعْلَمُ بِمَا یَصِفُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Repel, by [means of] what is best, [their] evil. We are most knowing of what they describe.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قُلْ رَّبِّ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزٰتِ الشَّیٰطِیْنِۙ
ayahs.translation: And say, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils,

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَعُوْذُ بِكَ رَبِّ اَنْ یَّحْضُرُوْنِ
ayahs.translation: And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me."

ayahs.arabicText: حَتّٰۤى اِذَا جَآءَ اَحَدَهُمُ الْمَوْتُ قَالَ رَبِّ ارْجِعُوْنِۙ
ayahs.translation: [For such is the state of the disbelievers], until, when death comes to one of them, he says, "My Lord, send me back

ayahs.arabicText: لَعَلِّیْۤ اَعْمَلُ صَالِحًا فِیْمَا تَرَكْتُ كَلَّا١ؕ اِنَّهَا كَلِمَةٌ هُوَ قَآئِلُهَا١ؕ وَ مِنْ وَّرَآئِهِمْ بَرْزَخٌ اِلٰى یَوْمِ یُبْعَثُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: That I might do righteousness in that which I left behind." No! It is only a word he is saying; and behind them is a barrier until the Day they are resurrected.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاِذَا نُفِخَ فِی الصُّوْرِ فَلَاۤ اَنْسَابَ بَیْنَهُمْ یَوْمَئِذٍ وَّ لَا یَتَسَآءَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: So when the Horn is blown, no relationship will there be among them that Day, nor will they ask about one another.

ayahs.arabicText: فَمَنْ ثَقُلَتْ مَوَازِیْنُهٗ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And those whose scales are heavy [with good deeds] - it is they who are the successful.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَازِیْنُهٗ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِیْنَ خَسِرُوْۤا اَنْفُسَهُمْ فِیْ جَهَنَّمَ خٰلِدُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: But those whose scales are light - those are the ones who have lost their souls, [being] in Hell, abiding eternally.

ayahs.arabicText: تَلْفَحُ وُجُوْهَهُمُ النَّارُ وَ هُمْ فِیْهَا كٰلِحُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: The Fire will sear their faces, and they therein will have taut smiles.

ayahs.arabicText: اَلَمْ تَكُنْ اٰیٰتِیْ تُتْلٰى عَلَیْكُمْ فَكُنْتُمْ بِهَا تُكَذِّبُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: [It will be said]. "Were not My verses recited to you and you used to deny them?"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا رَبَّنَا غَلَبَتْ عَلَیْنَا شِقْوَتُنَا وَ كُنَّا قَوْمًا ضَآلِّیْنَ
ayahs.translation: They will say, "Our Lord, our wretchedness overcame us, and we were a people astray.

ayahs.arabicText: رَبَّنَاۤ اَخْرِجْنَا مِنْهَا فَاِنْ عُدْنَا فَاِنَّا ظٰلِمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Our Lord, remove us from it, and if we were to return [to evil], we would indeed be wrongdoers."

ayahs.arabicText: قَالَ اخْسَئُوْا فِیْهَا وَ لَا تُكَلِّمُوْنِ
ayahs.translation: He will say, "Remain despised therein and do not speak to Me.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّهٗ كَانَ فَرِیْقٌ مِّنْ عِبَادِیْ یَقُوْلُوْنَ رَبَّنَاۤ اٰمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَ ارْحَمْنَا وَ اَنْتَ خَیْرُ الرّٰحِمِیْنَۚۖ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, there was a party of My servants who said, 'Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of the merciful.'

ayahs.arabicText: فَاتَّخَذْتُمُوْهُمْ سِخْرِیًّا حَتّٰۤى اَنْسَوْكُمْ ذِكْرِیْ وَ كُنْتُمْ مِّنْهُمْ تَضْحَكُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: But you took them in mockery to the point that they made you forget My remembrance, and you used to laugh at them.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنِّیْ جَزَیْتُهُمُ الْیَوْمَ بِمَا صَبَرُوْۤا١ۙ اَنَّهُمْ هُمُ الْفَآئِزُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, I have rewarded them this Day for their patient endurance - that they are the attainers [of success]."

ayahs.arabicText: قٰلَ كَمْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِی الْاَرْضِ عَدَدَ سِنِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: [Allah] will say, "How long did you remain on earth in number of years?"

ayahs.arabicText: قَالُوْا لَبِثْنَا یَوْمًا اَوْ بَعْضَ یَوْمٍ فَسْئَلِ الْعَآدِّیْنَ
ayahs.translation: They will say, "We remained a day or part of a day; ask those who enumerate."

ayahs.arabicText: قٰلَ اِنْ لَّبِثْتُمْ اِلَّا قَلِیْلًا لَّوْ اَنَّكُمْ كُنْتُمْ تَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: He will say, "You stayed not but a little - if only you had known.

ayahs.arabicText: اَفَحَسِبْتُمْ اَنَّمَا خَلَقْنٰكُمْ عَبَثًا وَّ اَنَّكُمْ اِلَیْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Then did you think that We created you uselessly and that to Us you would not be returned?"

ayahs.arabicText: فَتَعٰلَى اللّٰهُ الْمَلِكُ الْحَقُّ١ۚ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ١ۚ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِیْمِ
ayahs.translation: So exalted is Allah, the Sovereign, the Truth; there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Noble Throne.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَنْ یَّدْعُ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَ١ۙ لَا بُرْهَانَ لَهٗ بِهٖ١ۙ فَاِنَّمَا حِسَابُهٗ عِنْدَ رَبِّهٖ١ؕ اِنَّهٗ لَا یُفْلِحُ الْكٰفِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And whoever invokes besides Allah another deity for which he has no proof - then his account is only with his Lord. Indeed, the disbelievers will not succeed.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قُلْ رَّبِّ اغْفِرْ وَ ارْحَمْ وَ اَنْتَ خَیْرُ الرّٰحِمِیْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: And, [O Muhammad], say, "My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful."
